proxy.name: infath-out-bog-tanfeeth
proxy.description: Routes to different backend paths on a shared Target Server based on the incoming path, gated by a shared OAuth flow, with a service-unavailable fallback.

policies.name: FC-OAuth
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<FlowCallout continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="FC-OAuth">
    <DisplayName>FC-OAuth</DisplayName>
    <SharedFlowBundle>SF-OAuth</SharedFlowBundle>
</FlowCallout>

policies.name: AM-SetPath-ServiceA
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-SetPath-ServiceA">
    <DisplayName>AM-SetPath-ServiceA</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>CompletePathUrl</Name>
        <Value>/service-a/v1</Value>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: AM-SetPath-ServiceB
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-SetPath-ServiceB">
    <DisplayName>AM-SetPath-ServiceB</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>CompletePathUrl</Name>
        <Value>/service-b/v1</Value>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: FC-ServiceUnavailable
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<FlowCallout continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="FC-ServiceUnavailable">
    <DisplayName>FC-ServiceUnavailable</DisplayName>
    <SharedFlowBundle>SF-generalErrorHandling</SharedFlowBundle>
</FlowCallout>

policies.name: AM-Set-PathSuffix-url
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-Set-PathSuffix-url">
    <DisplayName>AM-Set-PathSuffix-url</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>target.copy.pathsuffix</Name>
        <Value>false</Value>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: EV-LookupType
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<ExtractVariables continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="EV-LookupType">
    <DisplayName>EV-LookupType</DisplayName>
    <Source clearPayload="false">request</Source>
    <URIPath>
        <Pattern ignoreCase="true">/GetLookup/{lookupType}</Pattern>
    </URIPath>
    <VariablePrefix>lookup</VariablePrefix>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>false</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</ExtractVariables>

targets.name: Bog-Tanfeeth-Server
targets.description: Path is resolved from CompletePathUrl, set by whichever conditional flow matched.

flows.name: GetLookUp
flows.description: Routes /service-a/* requests — sets CompletePathUrl before the TargetEndpoint runs.

flows.name: Service B
flows.description: Routes /service-b/* requests — sets CompletePathUrl before the TargetEndpoint runs.

flows.name: Default - Service Unavailable
flows.description: No condition — must stay last so it only catches requests that matched none of the routes above.
